name: checkpoint_plan_state
description: 计划执行关键节点状态快照与检查点创建技能。在关键卡点将当前计划状态序列化为 JSON 快照，计算快照哈希并原子持久化到检查点表，成功后记录审计日志并可选通过 SSE 推送检查点创建事件。
inputSchema: {"type":"object","additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"planId":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"description":"计划ID"},"phaseId":{"type":"string","description":"阶段ID，可选"},"nodeId":{"type":"string","description":"节点ID，可选"},"checkpointData":{"type":"string","minLength":2,"description":"检查点快照JSON字符串"},"createdBy":{"type":"string","description":"创建人或来源标识，可选"}},"required":["planId","checkpointData"]}
thoughtChain: 调用【save_checkpoint】检查点持久化工具，将 checkpointData 与 planId、phaseId、nodeId、createdBy 一并写入检查点表；写入前计算 SHA-256 作为 snapshotHash 并返回 checkpointId。
调用【audit_log】审计日志工具，记录 PLAN_CHECKPOINT_CREATED 事件，沉淀 checkpointId、snapshotHash 等关键字段。
调用【emit_event】SSE事件推送工具，向前端推送 PLAN_CHECKPOINT_CREATED 事件；推送失败不影响主流程返回。
